parts:
Hi,
I am a statistician and I am writing codes in R. I tried RRO and I was surprised that all my codes for explorative and survival analysis were running in it as well.
For one of the projects that I have been involved I started to use Power BI and Power BI designer.
Is it possible to run RRO in power BI and power BI (and/or designer)?! If so, can anyone tell me how to proceed? Or would anyone suggest me link where I can
look at?
Thank you,
Maria Anna
